companyType.description: Case-insensitive substring match on company type, e.g. Exempt Private, Public Company Limited by Guarantee.
companyType.title: Company type contains

entityStatus.description: Case-insensitive substring match on entity status, e.g. Live, Struck Off, Dissolved.
entityStatus.title: Entity status contains

entityType.description: Case-insensitive substring match on entity type: Local Company, Limited Liability Partnership, or Foreign Company Branch (the only types in this archive).
entityType.title: Entity type contains

limit.description: Maximum entity rows pushed to the dataset. Leave empty to return all matching rows.
limit.title: Max rows returned

mode.description: rows = matching entity rows to the dataset; analytics = derived analytics to the key-value store (record ANALYTICS); both = both.
mode.title: Mode

monthFrom.description: Earliest registration month to include, YYYY-MM. Prefilled with the snapshot's latest month so a default run returns just the new-registrations cohort.
monthFrom.title: Registration month from

monthTo.description: Latest registration month to include, YYYY-MM.
monthTo.title: Registration month to

nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on entity name.
nameContains.title: Entity name contains

onlyNewThisMonth.description: Restrict to entities registered in the snapshot's latest registration month (the new-registrations delta), ignoring monthFrom/monthTo.
onlyNewThisMonth.title: Only the latest month's new registrations

postalDistrict.description: Two-digit postal district (first two digits of the registered office postal code), e.g. 06, 18, 61.
postalDistrict.title: Postal district

ssicCode.description: Prefix match on primary or secondary SSIC code, e.g. 6201 or 681.
ssicCode.title: SSIC code prefix

ssicDivision.description: Two-digit SSIC division, matched as a prefix on primary or secondary SSIC code, e.g. 62 (computer programming), 56 (food & beverage), 68 (real estate).
ssicDivision.title: SSIC division (2-digit)
